sources.title: Assistant_Pepe_70B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Assistant_Pepe_70B is a 70-billion parameter large language model built by SicariusSicariiStuff that combines instruction-following capability with minimal content filtering and lateral thinking capabilities. The model is based on Llama 3.1-70B and fine-tuned with curated data including 4chan content, resulting in a model that ranked #1 on the UGI benchmark for 70B models as of April ...

sources.title: Assistant Pepe 70B tops Claude in lateral thinking — AICrier
sources.snippet: Assistant Pepe 70B is a Llama-3.1-based model fine-tuned on unconventional data to overcome "Assistant brain" and excel at creative reasoning. The model demonstrates a unique ability to solve trick questions that frequently stump frontier LLMs like Claude Sonnet 4.6.
